name: Dense Retrieval Hit-Rate
description: Phase 3 gate / Phase 5 baseline: conceptual questions over the article archive, scored by Recall@k — the fraction of expected keywords found among the top-k retrieved chunk texts. Curated 2026-11-27 against the live 7,006-article archive (May–Nov 2026), covering all 7 themes. Replaces the lost 8-question seed set (data/eval_retrieval_questions.json, baseline 0.833 on 2026-11-10 — not directly comparable).
